information_flow: The first call sees all common inputs and emits one binding exclusion charter containing rejected assumptions, the forbidden inherited mechanism, and validity obligations without any policy design. The final call sees that charter and all common inputs, retains executable anchor visibility as nonbinding evidence, holds the lineage's only constructive authority, and emits one policy without reopening the charter.
name: Subtractive Constitution to Independent Policy Origin

calls.objective: Identify which inherited structural assumptions must not govern this lineage and emit one binding exclusion charter. Exercise only subtractive authority: record the forbidden inherited mechanism and contract-validity obligations while withholding policy designs, implementation choices, and constructive prescriptions.

Consume the preceding exclusion charter as binding authority and use the common evidence to originate exactly one complete contract-compliant policy. Preserve interface, authoritative-state, capacity, and validity obligations; do not reinstate the rejected assumptions or the forbidden inherited mechanism.
